justification: DQ-145 116 -> 103: 26 unchecked council rows. Two page-proof fallbacks tried only after the exact-span proof fails (user yes 2026-10-18): full_text (whole row text, dropping only leading heading words, exact span on one page) and all_words_label (every word as often as used, whole numbers, values in the same order in one reading, and the rule's own Table/Figure/control label on the page). Applied live 12, then three Sol passes tightened the rule (multiplicity, page choice, value order) and 4 proofs that failed the stricter rule were reverted (guarded, backed up): 8 remain (3 full_text, 5 all_words_label), verifier 8/8. 5 Canterbury-Bankstown figure-label rows withheld. Parramatta C.09 items left marked (distinct rules, not duplicates).
